text: The Patriots absolutely demolished the Raiders 45-17 at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, with Drake Maye putting on a surgical display by accounting for five total touchdowns despite missing his top receiver and facing a secondary depleted by the absence of both starting cornerbacks—a testament to just how thoroughly the offense executed when it mattered. The victory came at a cost, however: TreVeyon Henderson left the game with an ankle injury, Will Campbell exited with a knee sprain, and veteran receiver Mack Hollins was placed on injured reserve Saturday with a calf injury, leaving Mike Vrabel's squad nursing some notable roster damage heading forward. Still, the raw dominance on display against Las Vegas, with eight notable takeaways from the performance, suggests the Patriots can impose their will even when key pieces go down, though the injury report will bear close monitoring in the coming days.
